turns.content: Hi, we're coming to Fossil Falls on Saturday and I have a few questions. The booking number is 88431.
Thanks, I have your booking open. What can I help with?
We bought the Fast Fossil pass for the four of us. My son Plato is eight and completely obsessed with raptors.
He will love the Raptor Paddock. The Fast Fossil pass covers it, along with every other ride except Swamp Safari.
Wait, it doesn't cover Swamp Safari? That was half the reason we bought it.
Swamp Safari runs one queue for everybody, so no pass skips it. Going in the first hour after opening keeps the wait short.
OK. Different problem. We came for a trial day last month and the turnstile wouldn't take our passes.
Do you remember what the screen said?
Some code. Let me find the photo. GATE-4102.
That means the pass was scanned three times within ten minutes and locked itself for thirty. Guest Services can clear it on the spot.
We were probably all scanning the same phone. Can we stop that happening again?
Send each person their own pass in the app, so each phone is scanned once.
Good idea. What about food? We're all vegetarian.
The Dino Diner cooks vegetarian food on a separate grill from the meat, and the menu marks every vegetarian dish.
Great. Is there shade in the queues? It's supposed to be hot.
The T. rex Kingdom and Swamp Safari queues are covered, and both run misting fans on hot days.
One more thing. My husband Aristotle made the booking, not me. Will the confirmation email go to him?
Yes, confirmations go to whoever made the booking, so Aristotle will get it.
And can we bring our own snacks?
Sealed snacks and water bottles are fine. Glass and hard coolers are not.
Perfect. I think we're all set.
Have a great visit.
